WHY-layers

    
Corpus-grounded reasoning notes per goal. Each layer is the engine's "why this product, why this dose" worked from Wallach's own books, with explicit firewall between Wallach-direct claims, Wallach-mechanism-extension, and framework-adjacent modern science.

  


  

    
Cognition — why-layer-cognition.md

    
Anchor: Eggs / cholesterol → bile salts → B12 absorption → myelin → cognition. The dietary fat-and-cholesterol baseline is not negotiable; choline-rich foods (egg yolks, organ meats, lecithin) are the structural substrate for acetylcholine and membrane phospholipids.

    
Wallach-direct stack: Synaptiv (pro-line cognitive), Bio-Alert (choline mega-dose), lecithin, Vit B-complex with active forms, Ultimate Smart FX (DHA + astaxanthin). Korsakoff is the corpus's clearest myelin-collapse case: B1 + lecithin + Cr + V.

    
Framework-adjacent caveats: Phosphatidylserine, lion's mane, citicoline — not in Wallach corpus. Use only if cofactors-first protocol exhausted.

  


  

    
Hormones & Strength — why-layer-hormones-strength.md

    
Anchor: Boron 9 mg/day approximately doubles serum testosterone AND estradiol within 7 days in deficient men (Naghii & Samman 1997, Wallach-cited). Zinc 150 mg/day (clinical, not RDA's 11 mg) is the second pillar — aromatase inhibition + LH support.

    
Wallach-direct stack: Tangy Tangerine 2.0 (Zn + B), Ultimate Selenium (Se for T4→T3 + Zn carrier), Beyond Tangy Tangerine 2.0 (boron carrier), MSM for connective tissue, Ultimate EFA Plus.

    
Critical interaction: Zn:Cu ratio at clinical doses (Zn 150 mg requires ~3-5 mg Cu cofactor or risk Cu-deficiency aneurysm pathway).

  


  

    
Longevity / Anti-aging — why-layer-longevity.md

    
Anchor: Wallach's "120-140 year potential" claim is built on the centenarian-belt fieldwork (Hunza, Vilcabamba, Abkhasia, Titicaca, Tibet) — all five share glacial-silt mineral water carrying 60+ trace elements. The 90 essentials are the operational instantiation. Cu deficiency → lysyl oxidase failure → aneurysm rupture is the named acute-death pathway.

    
Wallach-direct stack: Majestic Earth PDM Liquid (humic-shale 75 trace minerals), Beyond Tangy Tangerine 2.0, Ultimate Selenium, Ultimate EFA Plus, Beyond Osteo FX. Strength training preserved as Wallach-named lifespan modifier.

    
Framework-adjacent caveats: Resveratrol, NMN, rapamycin, senolytics, telomere tests — modern adjacencies not in corpus. Foundation first.

  


  
How the layers compose

  

    
Each WHY-layer follows the same internal structure: corpus-anchor passage → mechanism → Wallach-direct products → cofactor map → framework-adjacent dispositions → conflicts with mainstream medicine. The dashboard's Gaps tab + Live Coverage widget consume the same products-db; the WHY-layers tell you why the targets exist.

Tools & capabilities

    
Every tool the engine can call to ground an answer in Wallach's corpus or in the structured product / user data. Chronicle v? — ?.

  


  

    
Corpus retrieval

    
tools/corpus_search.py "<query>" — regex + structured-data heuristic + tier ranking (books > transcripts > products > non-YGY). Per-source cap to prevent one book dominating.

    
tools/symptom_lookup.py "<symptom>" — symptom or condition → Wallach-named deficiency causes + ranked YGY products carrying those nutrients (aligned forms first). Backed by 82-entry curated symptom→nutrient map plus 202 corpus-extracted conditions.

  


  

    
Stack analysis

    
tools/stack_coverage.py — joins user-stack.json × products-db.json × essentials-targets.json to produce dose-vs-target deltas, form-alignment per essential, current vs recommended scenarios. --include-diet and --diet-only flags fold dietary contribution from knowledge/diet-contribution.json. Feeds the Gaps tab Live Coverage widget.

    
tools/conflict_detector.py — programmatic checks for 21 Wallach-framework conflict rules: Zn:Cu balance, Ca:Mg ratio, caffeine vs Cr absorption, D3 without Mg/K2 cofactors, statin/grapefruit, yohimbe contraindications. Severity-tagged with source legend (wallach-direct / wallach-mechanism-extension / framework-adjacent).

  


  

    
Lab + catalog intelligence

    
tools/lab_interpreter.py — 24 lab markers (Vit D, B12, ferritin, TSH/Free T4/Free T3, homocysteine, lipid panel, glucose/A1c, full T panel, E2, SHBG, DHEA-S, cortisol, Vit A/E, iodine urine, Se, Mg-RBC, CRP-hs, uric acid) interpreted through Wallach-optimal ranges (often differ from standard) with deficiency pathways, first-action steps, and recommended YGY products per result. Supports single-marker, panel, and sex-specific queries.

    
tools/catalog_index.py — bidirectional product index. 18 goal categories × 39 nutrient keys × 201 products. Outputs nutrient-to-products.json, goal-to-products.json, and per-product coverage summary (essential coverage %, alignment score).

    
tools/label_scorer.py — scan any non-YGY product label (manual entry or JSON file). Produces: Wallach alignment score, personalized gap-fill table against your current 90-essentials coverage, goal-tag matches, conflict checks against your current stack, ingredient anti-list flags, framework-adjacent component callouts, and an ADD / REJECT / SAVE-FOR-LATER verdict. Persists to memory/product-wishlist.json via --wishlist add. Use it when you encounter a product in the wild and want to know if it fits your goals.

  


  
Knowledge base

  

    
Products: 201 Youngevity products, 193 vision-verified labels, 174 PDF descriptions extracted.

    
Corpus index: 202 conditions, 229 treatments, 858 dose mentions extracted from 4 Wallach books (~555K words). 82-entry symptom→nutrient curated map. 21 interaction/conflict rules. 24 lab markers.

    
Dietary layer: 8 foods in user's rotation profiled (eggs, salmon, chicken, skyr, cashews, coconut, dates, salt) with per-serving nutrient deltas.

    
WHY-layers: cognition (252 lines), hormones/strength (282 lines), longevity (297 lines), boron/bone, blood sugar, eyes.

    
Memory layer: identity, preferences, open-threads, essence (saga/lessons/decisions), archive. Continuity Protocol blocks new work if open-threads >7h stale.

  


  
Doctrine §11 firewall (unchanged)

  

    The user is not the source of truth. The Wallach corpus is the engine. Product data is a complement that completes but never drives. Modern adjacencies (resveratrol, NMN, lion's mane, telomere science, lutein/zeaxanthin/astaxanthin) are tagged as framework-adjacent — useful when foundation is solid, never a substitute for the 90 essentials.
